steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The practical assessment requires you to build, test and document a circuit under controlled conditions within a set time. | Key Fact: Read the task brief completely before starting; identify the circuit to build, the measurements required and the documentation expected. | Key Fact: Plan your construction before building: identify components, plan the breadboard layout and check you have all parts. | Key Fact: Build the circuit methodically, section by section, and visually inspect each connection before powering on.
